quarterly_data.signal: Q1 revenue well above guidance of around 15% growth, primarily driven by continued acceleration of AI-related activities with Photonic SOI sales doubling year-on-year; Edge & Cloud AI revenue EUR 65 million, up 47% year-over-year, with Photonics more than half of it; Mobile Communications EUR 39 million, down 10%
quarterly_data.figure: revenue EUR 113 million, up 23% year-on-year at constant currency and scope, vs guidance of around 15%

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 FY2027 revenue expected up more than 30% year-on-year, sustained by the Photonic SOI acceleration; assuming no material disruption in the AI market, Photonic SOI FY2027 revenue expected to more than double the FY2026 level, which was slightly above $100 million; FY2027 CapEx cash out still expected around EUR 100 million
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 revenue up more than 30% YoY; Photonic SOI FY2027 to more than double FY2026's slightly above $100 million

quarterly_data.signal: More than 10 Photonic SOI customers, with multi-year capacity reservation agreements negotiated with most of them, including agreed prices, down payments or deposits, and visibility on customer inventory; commitments now extend beyond fiscal year 2027
quarterly_data.figure: more than 10 customers in Photonic SOI; multi-year commitments extending beyond FY2027

quarterly_data.signal: Singapore 300-millimeter SOI fab qualified for high-volume Photonic SOI manufacturing with first customers, accelerated from an initial end-of-calendar-year plan; no bottleneck — 'lead time to peak' rather than a capacity limit, leveraging fungibility across SOI products; V4 module expansion starting in Bernin and the Singapore building can be equipped further; Q1 average fab loading 48% (down from 74% a year earlier on inventory reduction), around 65% average expected for the year
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 fab loading 48% vs 74% a year earlier; ~65% average loading expected for the year

quarterly_data.signal: Photonic SOI addresses pluggable transceivers, near package optics (NPO) and co-packaged optics (CPO); most current revenue and growth comes from scale-out, mostly pluggables, with NPO taking share and CPO expected to ramp on scale-out at the end of the year; scale-up is starting with pluggables and will move to CPO; roughly the same Photonic SOI content in all these architectures

RF-SOI channel inventory reduced to about 1.7 million wafer 8-inch equivalents from roughly 2 million in March, against an estimated sell-out of about 1.5 million wafer equivalents per year — still some way to go back to pre-COVID levels; POI position reinforced by the long-term agreement recently entered into with Skyworks for next generation architectures
quarterly_data.figure: RF-SOI channel inventory 1.7 million wafer 8-inch equivalents, down from 2 million in March

connects_to.relationship: raw silicon wafer supply partner for Soitec's SOI substrate manufacturing

contracts.signal: Shin-Etsu Handotai named as one of Soitec's wafer partners on input costs; Soitec says the supplier situation is tense but manageable, with a diversified supplier base and contribution (selling price minus raw material prices) improving slightly this year
